NEWS 


FROM THE MONTREAL YMCA 


1441 DRUMMOND ST., MONTREAL 
TELEPHONE 849-5331, EXT. 57 


February 4, 1965 


For Immediate Release 


ROTARY ~ Y.M.C.A, PARTNERS IN LEADERSHIP PROJECT 


Some 50 teen-agers, representing more than 20 local community organizations 
will take part in an intensive leadership development project at the 


Downtown Y.M.C.A. this week-end. 


The program is sponsored by the Youth Services Committee of the Rotary 
Club of Montreal with leadership provided by seven professional Y.M.C.A. 
members, Director of the project is Rix Rogers, Coordinator of Program 


and Staff Development for the Montreal Y.M.C.A. 


The teen-agers will learn by "doing" basic leadership skills in a 
laboratory setting. The program which was initiated last year as a pilot 
project of the Rotary Club, will open with a banquet on Friday evening 


and sessions will continue through till Sunday afternoon. 


For further information contact: 
Rix Rogers - Montreal Y.M.C.A. - Phone VI9-5331 
Frank Peterson - Rotary Club of Montreal - Phone 842-9531 


Ted Lowe ~ Montreal Y.M.C.A. Public Relations -— Phone VI9-5331
